reviewMethod: Every actual screenshot opened with view_image at full viewport; hashes rechecked.

reviewed.label: stairs-lower
reviewed.observation: Three squad sprites stand at the lower council approach, feet and contact shadows visible; four physical steps are clear.

reviewed.label: stairs-middle
reviewed.observation: This capture still shows the lower placement; the label does not itself establish a middle-step position. The later upper export establishes actual traversal.

reviewed.label: stairs-upper
reviewed.observation: The N7 leader is on the raised landing; followers occupy the stair approach, with floor-relative feet and shadows.

reviewed.label: stairs-returned
reviewed.observation: The leader has descended to the lower approach; followers are staggered on the stairs. A public banter panel appears below the scene without hiding the steps.

reviewed.label: pillar-before
reviewed.observation: The leader is hidden behind the nearest opaque Citadel column, while the two followers remain visible to its left. The label before refers to capture order.

reviewed.label: pillar-behind
reviewed.observation: The leader has emerged to the right of that column, and another squad member remains concealed. The label behind is not a claim that this frame has the most hidden leader.

reviewed.label: pillar-emerged
reviewed.observation: All three squad sprites are visible on the right of the column; the opaque column has no character fragments showing through its solid face.

reviewed.label: camera-threshold-stop
reviewed.observation: The camera shows a stable right-side Citadel view, but the actual export is x18.65; the intended threshold was not crossed.

reviewed.label: camera-threshold-stationary
reviewed.observation: Architecture framing matches the stopped view, with ordinary ambient changes. This cannot validate a threshold crossing that did not occur.

reviewed.label: failure
reviewed.observation: The same stationary view includes a real banter panel. The collector failed its x>=18.75 assertion; no runtime error or gameplay defect is shown.

scope: The two completed public stair/pillar groups were visually inspected. This failed attempt does not close camera threshold or retreat boundary criteria.
failure: 65ms keyboard hold produced no sampled movement; real export x18.65 failed x>=18.75. Only collector hold duration is adjusted for next attempt.
limitations: Images remain unedited and preserve ordinary public HUD, toast and banter overlays.
No original-level fidelity, hardware FPS or complete camera criterion is claimed.
